listenings.text: Good afternoon, Mister Luiz. This is your travel confirmation. Your flight leaves on October twenty-third, at ten in the evening, and you are going to arrive at JFK at seven in the morning. Your hotel is in Manhattan, and check-in is at three in the afternoon. You are going to receive the tickets by email today. If you are going to take extra luggage, please tell us before Friday. Thank you.

Hi Rodrigo, this is David from the New York office. Welcome in advance. Here is the plan for your first day. I am going to meet you at the hotel at eight thirty. We are going to walk to the office, it is only ten minutes. In the morning you are going to meet the team, and after lunch you are going to present the Brazilian numbers. It is going to be a good week. See you soon.

extra_audio.text: Rodrigo is going to book the flight this week. He is going to leave Sao Paulo on the twenty-third of October. He is going to arrive at the airport in New York in the morning. A car is going to take him to the hotel. After six days of work he is going to stay fourteen more days on holiday.

paras: This is the plan for the New York trip. You are going to leave Sao Paulo on October twenty-third, at ten in the evening.
The flight is nine hours. You are going to arrive at JFK airport in the morning. A car from the company is going to take you to the hotel in Manhattan.
You are going to work with the American team for six days. On the first morning you are going to visit the office, and in the afternoon you are going to present the Brazilian numbers.
After the six days you are going to stay fourteen more days on holiday. You are not going to work in that week, and nobody is going to call you.
